messages:
ivy: quick SR audit after the banner change. noticed a few things: 1) primary CTA in the top banner drops below 4.5:1 on light theme, 2) opening the right details panel moves focus to the panel container but VoiceOver still reads the first form label twice, 3) sortable table headers don't expose aria-sort when toggled. screencap: https://assets.redwood/ui/banner-cta.mp4 :mag:

mark: thanks — good catches. CTA color hex?

ivy: CTA bg #ffd54f on white and label #0b1220. contrast is ~4.2:1; small text needs 4.5:1. propose darken to #f2c02a or make the button medium weight bumped to 14px.

jess: about the duplicate label: looks like we render a visually-hidden label for field and the form lib also injects aria-label. quick patch: remove the injected aria-label and rely on the visible label + an sr-only helper for complex descriptions. also check `aria-describedby` use.

carlos: panel focus bug: our focus-trap sets focus on the container which isn't tabbable, so AT falls back and may read page behind. fix: move initial focus to first tabbable control or add tabindex="-1" to panel title and focus that. i'll update the focus-trap util.

a11y-bot: scan results (axe): 6 issues — color-contrast (1), duplicate-id (1), focus-order (1), aria-attributes (2), table-headers (1). full: https://ci.redwood/axe/1747459999

mark: sortable headers: add `aria-sort="none"` initially and toggle to `ascending`/`descending`. also ensure the button has `aria-label="Sort by Name, currently ascending"` for clarity.

jess: microcopy suggestion: change banner CTA from "Try it" to "Start a free run" — clearer and helps screen reader users understand intent.

carlos: i'll open a focused PR: 1) CTA color adjustment + visual QA 2) focus-trap fix 3) remove duplicate aria-labels in form lib 4) table header aria-sort updates. aiming EOD tomorrow.

ivy: i'll run VoiceOver + NVDA passes once PR lands and add a tiny regression test verifying `aria-sort` presence and that the panel initial focus lands on a control.

mark: small win — let's also add an automated test that fails if any button has duplicate aria-label attributes. prevents the form-lib regression happening again.

jess: agree. i'll include that in component tests. thanks everyone :sparkles:
